title: US Treasury Interest Rate Tracker Input

securityKeyword.title: Security keyword
securityKeyword.description: Case-insensitive match against the security description, e.g. "Treasury Bills", "Treasury Notes", "Treasury Bonds", "TIPS", "Total Interest-bearing Debt". Leave blank to return all security categories.

monthsBack.title: Months back
monthsBack.description: How many months of history to fetch, by record date. Data is published monthly.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of monthly records to return, most recent first.
